report.answer_text:
Chelsea won the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup. They beat Paris Saint-Germain 3–0 in the final.
Where: The tournament was held in the United States. The final was played at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey, near New York City, on July 13, 2025.
Player of the match: Cole Palmer of Chelsea.
Attendance: 81,118.
Significance: It was Chelsea's second Club World Cup title.
The page I found gave an unreliable list of scorers, so I've left them out.
